```{r}
#| include: false

source("R/efile_helpers.R")

rel    <- efile_release("v2_3")
counts <- efile_nonempty(efile_counts(rel))
meta   <- efile_release_meta(rel, counts$table)
fil    <- efile_filings(counts)
yrs    <- range(counts$year)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(efile_banner(rel))
```

| | |
|:--|:--|
| **Release** | `r efile_label(rel)` (published `r rel$published`) |
| **Returns** | Form 990 and Form 990-EZ, with schedules |
| **Tax years** | `r yrs[1]`&ndash;`r yrs[2]` |
| **Tables** | `r length(unique(counts$table))` tables, `r fmt_n(nrow(counts))` table-year files |
| **Filings** | `r fmt_n(sum(fil$rows_tot))` returns |

Each table-year is published as CSV and Parquet. Data dictionary links point to the current concordance990 dictionary, so a few variables may differ from the ones in this release.

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(efile_pin_note(rel))
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(efile_toc(meta, c("version-history" = "Version history")))
```

## Version history {#version-history}

```{r}

cat(efile_version_history(rel$id))
```

# Available tables {#tables}

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(efile_table_sections(counts, meta, rel, snippet = FALSE))
```

<p style='font-size: 0.85em; color: #666; margin-top: 2em;'>Table list and row counts: `r rel$count_file`. Page rendered `r format(Sys.Date())`.</p>
